title: Bearing-Only Formation Tracking Control for Euler-Lagrange Multi-Agent Systems Without Inter-Agent Communication
summary: This paper investigates communication-free bearing-only formation tracking control for multi-agent systems governed by Euler-Lagrange dynamics. Distinct from existing results that can only stabilize a stationary formation, this work considers a scenario where the leaders move with time-varying velocities while the inter-agent communication is absent.
